params.prompt: The exact same obsidian cathedral cavern, same prism heart, same composition: but now the prism heart has ignited from within, glowing white-hot at its core, and thin veins of cyan and violet light race outward from it through the dark crystal walls like lines of fire; half the cavern still asleep in deep shadow on the left, the right half veined with spreading spectral light; the first soft god ray appears through haze above; shadow still dominates the frame, color lives only in the thin veins and the heart's core; dozens of lit veins, not hundreds; deep rich blacks, soft bloom, exquisite detail; no text, no logos, no people
